title: High-Nuclearity Heterometallic tert-Butylethynide Clusters Assembled with tert-Butylphosphonate

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.formula: C91 H131 Ag16 Cl F24 O26 P3 Yb3 · CH4O · H2O

synthesis.procedure: tert-Butylsilver acetylide and AgBF4 were dissolved in methanol/dichloromethane (1:1, 6 mL), followed by tetramethylammonium chloride. A methanolic solution (5 mL) of Yb(hfac)3(H2O)2 and tert-butylphosphonic acid was added. The mixture was stirred for 30 min; a clear solution was obtained after 1 h. Slow evaporation afforded colorless crystals.
synthesis.time: Stirred for 30 min; clear solution after 1 h
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Solution reaction followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Slow evaporation of the clear solution yielded colorless crystals.

properties.summary: In solution at room temperature, compound 1 exhibits a broad near-infrared Yb(III) emission band assigned to the ²F5/2 → ²F7/2 transition.

measurements.name: Emission maximum
measurements.conditions: Solution, room temperature; broad emission band from 950 to 1050 nm

source_locations.location: Supplied CCDC catalog row KIFTUR (1584675); Ag16Yb3 composition matches compound 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A chloride-templated Ag16 ethynide unit is fused through tert-butylphosphonate bridges to a trinuclear hydroxoytterbium phosphonate unit.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.formula: C146 H256 Ag32 Cl2 F24 O56 P8 Yb6 · 2(CH4O)

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the procedure reported for compound 1, but using 9 mg (0.06 mmol) of tert-butylphosphonic acid instead of 6 mg (0.04 mmol). Thus, tert-butylsilver acetylide and AgBF4 were dissolved in methanol/dichloromethane, tetramethylammonium chloride was added, and a methanolic solution of Yb(hfac)3(H2O)2 and tert-butylphosphonic acid was introduced. The solution was stirred and allowed to evaporate slowly to produce crystals.
synthesis.time: As for compound 1: stirred for 30 min; clear solution after 1 h
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Solution reaction followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Slow evaporation as described for compound 1.

properties.summary: In solution at room temperature, compound 2 exhibits a broad near-infrared Yb(III) emission band assigned to the ²F5/2 → ²F7/2 transition.

measurements.name: Emission maximum
measurements.conditions: Solution, room temperature; broad emission band from 950 to 1050 nm

source_locations.location: Supplied CCDC catalog row KIFVAZ (1584676); Ag32Yb6 composition matches compound 2

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Two chloride-templated Ag16 ethynide units are bridged by a central hexanuclear oxo/hydroxoytterbium phosphonate unit.
